name: testland/db-query-plan-analyzer
description: Use for any question or task about a slow SQL query or a database bottleneck, including how to read EXPLAIN or EXPLAIN ANALYZE output and database CPU that saturates under load. Reads plans from PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQLite, finds the main cost (sequential scans, nested loops, sort spills, missing or unusable indexes) and proposes the index or query rewrite.
